questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto bit at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (2, 1), then ramp_right at (3, 2), then ramp_left at (4, 3), then ramp_right at (3, 4), then ramp_left at (4, 5), then ramp_right at (3, 6), then ramp_left at (4, 7), then ramp_right at (3, 8), then ramp_left at (4, 9), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: What is the output pattern?
questions.answer: 12 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits left, blue exits right, red exits left. 8 exit left, 4 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: Trace the state of the bit after each of the first 4 blue balls.
questions.answer: Ball 1: bit starts at 1 (right), ball goes right and flips bit to 0. Ball 2: bit at 0 (left), ball goes left and flips bit to 1. Ball 3: bit at 1 (right), ball goes right and flips bit to 0. Ball 4: bit at 0 (left), ball goes left and flips bit to 1.
